images.title: Seven ways of travelling
images.purpose: Show the 4 ways of travelling named for long ago and the 3 named for about a hundred years ago on one time line, so the count 4 + 3 = 7 and the order of boat and bullock cart are visible.
images.composition: One row of 7 picture cards in time order with a bracket and a count over each group, a time arrow under the row and the sum at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One centred row of 7 equal picture cards, each about 175 by 200 px, 20 px apart, each with a pale flat background and a thin dark outline, left to right: card 1, a traveller walking on foot with a stick and a bundle; card 2, a person riding a horse; card 3, a small wooden boat with 1 oar on water; card 4, a sailing ship with 2 sails; card 5, a bullock cart with 1 bullock; card 6, an old-style car; card 7, a small steam train with an engine and 1 carriage. Under each card its caption in clear dark sans-serif (34 px): on foot, on animals, in boats, in ships, animal-drawn carts, cars, trains. Above the row two brackets: a blue #0072B2 bracket over cards 1 to 4 with the header Long ago, and an amber #E69F00 bracket over cards 5 to 7 with the header About a hundred years ago. Card 3 (boat) and card 5 (cart) have a thick reddish purple #CC79A7 outline. Under the captions, centred under each bracket's span, one large numeral (100 px, bold): 4 in blue under cards 1 to 4 and 3 in amber under cards 5 to 7. Below that, a thin grey #6B7280 arrow pointing right along the full width of the row, with the word Older at its left end and the word Newer at its right end. At the bottom centre the sum 4 + 3 = 7 in very large bold dark numerals (110 px), the largest text in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The story names 4 ways of travelling from long ago and 3 from about a hundred years ago, 7 in all, and a boat is older than a bullock cart.
images.description: A time line of seven pictures: on foot, on animals, in boats and in ships under Long ago, then animal-drawn carts, cars and trains under About a hundred years ago, with 4 + 3 = 7.
images.context: Concept image for the Travelling Then and Now video, drawn from its own worked example (4 ways long ago, 3 vehicles about a hundred years ago). Your maths book has no figure for this idea, only the opening story, so the pictures are simple icons and no dates or distances are shown.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which came first, a boat or a bullock cart, and let students point at the two ringed cards. The arrow shows older to newer only; it does not say how many years separate the cards. Do not add speeds or dates.

image_decisions.why: One time line of the seven ways of travelling shows the count and which way is older at a glance.
